# A02-S86: Artistic freedom

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…] 

So it’s been broken ;-) I wanted to write to you and update about the situation, but not much concrete has happened because there’s still no contract. Something about some new lawyers, and the usual procrastination. Have some good stories from the [████] presentation, which was a kind of geek show, full of swastikas and penises (seriously...).

In the agreement I have cobbled together, I have total freedom, so I think it will probably be fine. Sounds like a good idea to go into climate and geopolitics, I’d like to hear more about that.

Let’s talk soon :-)

[…]
